aboutMe.title: About me
aboutMe.intro: Before turning programming into my career, I worked as an electronics technician for automation technology. That experience taught me how to narrow down problems systematically, understand technical relationships and work with precision. My interest in programming started out of curiosity when I was a teenager. Today, I enjoy building applications from the ground up and care just as much about clean code as I do about making them simple and intuitive to use.
aboutMe.location: Based in Stuttgart, Germany, I enjoy working remotely and collaborating with teams across different time zones.
aboutMe.learning: Learning new technologies and continuously improving my skills is an important part of how I work. Right now, I'm deepening my knowledge of Angular and TypeScript. Next, I want to expand my focus into backend technologies.
aboutMe.problemSolving: Breaking problems into smaller parts and looking at them from different perspectives comes naturally to me. A solution is worth refining until it not only works, but also feels right. My approach to development is analytical and detail-oriented, with a strong focus on getting the small things right. Creativity, persistence and good collaboration matter just as much as clean and efficient code.

skillSet.title: Skills
skillSet.intro: My current focus is modern frontend development with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript and Angular. I care about responsive interfaces, clear structures and readable code. Through my projects, I have also gained experience working with APIs, Git and GitHub, as well as building larger applications in a structured way. My next focus is expanding my backend development skills.
skillSet.ctaText: I enjoy learning new technologies. If your project requires a skill I have not worked with yet, I'm happy to dive into the topic and build the knowledge I need.

featuredProjects.title: Featured Projects
featuredProjects.intro: My projects show how I turn requirements into working applications. Feel free to try them out and take a look at the code on GitHub.

join.description: A task manager inspired by the Kanban system. Tasks can be created, organized and moved between different sections using drag and drop. Users and categories can also be assigned to individual tasks. (Placeholder)

elPolloLoco.description: A 2D platformer built with an object-oriented JavaScript architecture. The project includes game logic, animations, collision detection, enemy behavior, collectible items and a final boss. The main focus was creating a clear class structure and applying object-oriented programming in practice.

pokedex.description: A dynamic Pokédex web app powered by the PokéAPI. The application loads Pokémon data at runtime, processes API responses and provides search functionality along with detailed information for each Pokémon. Additional features such as lazy loading and dynamically loaded evolution data help create an efficient and responsive experience.

hosting.heading: 2. Hosting
hosting.paragraph1: This website and my email account are hosted by Hetzner Online GmbH, Industriestraße 25, 91710 Gunzenhausen, Germany.
hosting.paragraph2: When you visit this website, technical server log data is processed. This may include the requested page, date and time, browser information and an anonymised IP address.
hosting.paragraph3: Server logs are stored for seven days by default and are then deleted.
hosting.paragraph4: Processing is based on Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. My legitimate interest is the secure and technically reliable operation of this website.
hosting.paragraph5: A data processing agreement in accordance with Art. 28 GDPR is in place with Hetzner.

contact.heading: 3. Contact Form and Email
contact.paragraph1: If you contact me through the contact form, your name, email address and message are processed.
contact.paragraph2: The information is sent directly to my email account at Hetzner through a server-side PHP script. The form data is not additionally stored in a database.
contact.paragraph3: If your enquiry relates to a potential collaboration or steps taken before entering into a contract, processing is based on Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR. Other enquiries are processed on the basis of Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR.
contact.paragraph4: The same applies when you contact me directly by email.
contact.paragraph5: Contact enquiries and related emails are deleted no later than three months after the enquiry has been completed, unless legal retention requirements or other legitimate reasons require longer storage.

cookies.heading: 4. Cookies, Tracking and External Services
cookies.paragraph1: This website does not use cookies, analytics tools, tracking technologies or marketing services.
cookies.paragraph2: All fonts are hosted locally on my own web space. No connection to Google Fonts or other external font providers is established when the website loads.
cookies.paragraph3: GitHub and LinkedIn are linked as external websites. A connection to these providers is only established when you open the respective link.
